name: command-10
description: A compact emoji search that filters reactions by name and keyword aliases.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Command, CommandEmpty, CommandGroup, CommandInput, CommandItem, CommandList, } from "@workspace/ui/components/command" const emojis = [ { char: "👍", name: "Thumbs up", keywords: ["like", "approve", "yes"] }, { char: "🎉", name: "Party popper", keywords: ["celebrate", "tada", "launch"], }, { char: "❤️", name: "Red heart", keywords: ["love", "favorite"] }, { char: "😂", name: "Tears of joy", keywords: ["funny", "lol", "laugh"] }, { char: "👀", name: "Eyes", keywords: ["look", "review", "watching"] }, { char: "🚀", name: "Rocket", keywords: ["ship", "deploy", "fast"] }, { char: "🔥", name: "Fire", keywords: ["hot", "lit", "trending"] }, { char: "✅", name: "Check mark", keywords: ["done", "complete"] }, ] export default function EmojiReactionSearch() { const [picked, setPicked] = React.useState([]) return (
Reactions: {picked.map((char, index) => ( {char} ))}
No emoji found. {emojis.map((emoji) => ( setPicked((current) => [...current, emoji.char].slice(-8)) } > {emoji.char} {emoji.name} :{emoji.keywords[0]}: ))}
) }
